mapper.select: SELECT w.wallet_id, w.currency_code, w.available_balance, w.wallet_status FROM wallets w JOIN wallet_owners o ON o.wallet_owner_id = w.wallet_owner_id WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT wallet_id, currency_code, available_balance, wallet_status FROM wallets WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
